EC1: Non-reassuring fetal assessment at the time of recruitment
EC2: Previous cervical ripening agents (cytotec [OR], cervidil [OR], cervical Foley Balloon)
EC5: Any patients contraindicated [AND] for vaginal delivery
EC8: Patients with history of significant cardiac disease
EC10: Estimated fetal weight greater than 4500 grams in diabetic and 5000 grams in [NOT] non-diabetic mother
EC13: Augmentation of labor (latent [OR] or active phase)
